agentbench.name: AgentBench
agentbench.coverageNote: No new absolute scores on the ORIGINAL AgentBench benchmark were published in the 2026-06-19 to 2026-06-28 window. Sources checked: (1) Official THUDM/AgentBench GitHub repo and its linked Google Sheet leaderboard — the current official leaderboard is for AgentBench FC (Function Calling), a VARIANT introduced 2025-10-10, not the original 8-environment free-form-action benchmark. GitHub last pushed 2026-02-08. (2) Third-party aggregators importing from the official sheet: BenchmarkList (sampled 2026-05-06) and Steel.dev (updated 2026-04-16) — both predate the window and show the same scores already tracked. (3) Presenc AI agentic leaderboard (June 2026) lists ~10 models with tilde-approximate AgentBench scores (e.g., ~80%, ~78%, ~76%) but explicitly disclaims precision ('numbers should be treated as directional'), uses no primary source, and does not specify benchmark edition — fails the absolute-score standard. (4) RapidClaw blog (2026-05-06) reports approximate (~) values — predates window and fails absolute standard. (5) AgentWiki lists scores without edition attribution or per-score dates. (6) GPT-5.6 Sol announcement (openai.com, ~2026-06-26) contains zero AgentBench mentions. (7) HuggingFace model cards only show individual-environment LoRA adapters, not overall scores. (8) arXiv: no papers in window report original AgentBench scores. Critical structural finding: all scores currently on the official leaderboard are AgentBench FC (variant) scores; no original-benchmark leaderboard is currently maintained. Coverage gaps: the Google Sheet could not be directly rendered (dynamic content); Presenc AI and AgentWiki values are approximate/undated and cannot serve as citable absolute numbers.
